name: Crispy Chicken & Waffles with Strawberry, Arugula and Feta Salad (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Cut butter into small pieces, place in a small bowl, and set aside to soften.
Place mayo and spices in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
¼ tsp paprika
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Slice crosswise into ¾-inch thick strips, add to the bowl with the spiced mayo, and toss to coat. Add bread crumbs to the bowl, then toss once more to coat the chicken strips.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
⅔ cup panko bread crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Transfer chicken strips to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (454 g) pkg strawberries
1 kiwifruit
½ mango
½ lemon
½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim and thinly slice strawberries. Place half in a clean medium bowl. (Reserve remaining strawberries for later use.)
Peel, trim, and quarter kiwi lengthwise, then slice crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the strawberries.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the fruit salad, and set aside.

Zest lemon into the bowl with the softened butter, then add maple syrup, crushed red pepper, and salt. Mash with the back of a spoon until smooth and combined, then set aside. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
pure maple syrup
¼ tsp crushed red pepper
salt

instructions.primary_message: Place waffles in the oven (either directly on the rack or on another baking sheet) and bake until crisp and warmed through, about 2 minutes. (Alternatively, cook according to package instructions.)
While the waffles are baking, juice reserved lemon into another medium bowl. Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
pure maple syrup
⅛ tsp basil, dried
⅛ tsp salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add reserved strawberries, arugula, and feta to the bowl with the dressing. Toss to combine the strawberry-arugula salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Cut 2 waffles into 1-inch strips, then divide between plates along with 6 chicken strips and fruit salad. Serve with maple syrup for dipping. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining waffles, chicken strips, and strawberry-arugula salad between plates. Top waffles with the spicy maple butter and enjoy!
